ai_summary: 5paisa Capital Limited reported a sharp decline in Q2 FY27 profitability, with Profit After Tax (PAT) falling 39% quarter-over-quarter, primarily due to a 15% drop in Average Daily Turnover (ADTO) and increased operating expenses. Despite a successful ₹469 Cr rights issue and continued client acquisition efforts, these strategic investments have not yet translated into positive financial returns, impacting overall operational efficiency. The significant deterioration in bottom-line performance amid ongoing growth initiatives represents a material impact and a key red flag for short-term financial health.
